propositions: Every newly certified plan review must emit exactly one deterministic canonical pin per direct child and per direct prerequisite, sorted lexicographically by role then canonical ID, carrying the 16-hex material fingerprint of the target.

Pin collection must occur before any LLM evaluation; unreadable or unresolvable targets return unsigned INDETERMINATE with an exact PlanRelationSnapshotError reason (missing-target, ambiguous-reference, malformed-reference, reducer-error, canonical-id-mismatch, or store-read-failure) without traceback or partial pins.

PlanRelationSnapshot must preload all ticket states store-wide including archived tickets, scan both outgoing depends_on and inbound blocks to discover arbitrary blockers, and capture a clean tickets-tracker HEAD via git status and rev-parse.

The manifest format must encode plan-material-pin lines deterministically after verified-at-sha and before dep lines, with parser and builder supporting empty pin sequences for backward compatibility with legacy unsigned manifests.

All plan-review signing paths (sign_plan_review, refresh_attestation, resign_plan_review) must call collect_plan_relation_snapshot unconditionally and pass the complete related_material; deleted targets prevent refresh/re-sign until the relationship is repaired.
